sonnet.problem: The card says "Ninth year. Tenth year. ELEVENTH year of Zedekiah's reign." The BSB gives the ninth year, tenth month (39:1) and the eleventh year, fourth month (39:2). A tenth year is never mentioned. The card turns the tenth month into a tenth year, which stretches the text.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
